title: Templars as keepers of advanced knowledge and a bloodline of Christ

tellings.quote: because because I do think that the Templars were custodians of of advanced knowledge and they were also supposed to have you know protected maybe a a bloodline of Christ.

plain: A researcher named Randall Carlson, on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, says he believes the Knights Templar, a medieval order of knights in France whose leader Jacques de Molay was brought down around 1307, guarded advanced knowledge. He adds that they were also said to protect a bloodline of Christ, which would mean a hidden lineage and lost wisdom passed down in secret.
